name: Multi-Agent Review nav item + route open in Configure mode
description: Proves AC-34 (the 'Multi-Agent Review' left-nav item exists and routes to /repos/<id>/multi-agent) and AC-2 (with no seeded multi-run, the page opens in Configure mode — the 'Run a Multi-Agent Review' Step 1/Step 2 form with the PR picker and the 'Run multi-agent review (N)' launch control). Deterministic + LLM-free: launching a REAL multi-run invokes the reviewer agents (an LLM), which e2e NEVER does, so the launch->Results transition and the Results view (Columns/Tabs toggle, View trace, 'Show only conflicts', zero-findings empties) are covered by the Phase-8 client component tests (ConfigureRun/ColumnsView/ConflictsBlock/TabsView .test.tsx), NOT here. The nav label is a real <a> (NavItem wraps Link), so a text click navigates. Avoids `wait --load networkidle` on the app root (the seed repo acme/payments-api hits live GitHub on the home redirect — the spec-01 flake) and asserts its own deterministic locators. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (acme/payments-api).

steps.label: land on the seeded repo's PR list
PR list heading renders (client + API + DB live)
click the Multi-Agent Review nav item (AC-34)
opens in Configure mode — no seeded multi-run (AC-2)
